items.headline: Four municipal permit feeds refresh the data-centre activity proxy
items.observed_change: Official municipal APIs were retrieved on 2026-09-03. The controlled screens retain 17 Edmonton, 13 Vancouver, 53 Toronto and 14 Montréal candidate permit records. The aligned comparison panel contains 456 market-quarter-asset rows; the descriptive association uses 444 rows.
items.model_implication: Retain the refreshed records as administrative activity proxies and review record-level changes. Do not treat permit counts, declared values or completion milestones as realized AI construction spending, labour hours, public-project outcomes or an attributable escalation coefficient.
